name: hook
speech: Agent frameworks make you build the machine: graphs, nodes, edges, state, retries.
caption: Frameworks make you build the machine

name: turn
speech: Rein flips it. You don't wire the agent. You tell it what to do.
caption: Rein flips it. You say what to do.

name: function-is-file
speech: Every decision is a small function, and every function is its own file. Each one starts with a description of what it decides.
caption: One decision, one function, one file

name: inputs-are-questions
speech: A function's inputs are questions. The agent answers them from what it sees: yes or no, or one of a few options.
caption: Inputs are questions the agent answers

name: two-moves
speech: Inside, there are only two moves: if, and switch. No loops, by design, for now.
caption: Only two moves: if, and switch

name: every-path-ends
speech: Every path ends in one of two things: a plain instruction for the agent, or a pointer to the next function.
caption: Every path ends in one of two things

name: flow
speech: The agent starts at the project's main function. It answers only the questions on its path, and follows pointers until it gets its instruction.
caption: Start at main. Answer. Follow the pointers.

name: safety
speech: A checker makes sure every path returns, and every pointer is real. The editor shows it as you type.
caption: Checked as you type

name: close
speech: Rein. Instructions, not infrastructure. Alpha, coming soon.
caption: Instructions, not infrastructure.
